executable_actions.rationale: Repair only the earliest defensible exact-board contract defect. Regenerate a fingerprint-valid board causal context; replace the contradictory start-before-ingress diagnostic with the certified accepted-ingress lifecycle rule; declare the board adapter and all 13 current kernel DAG boundaries; move probes to simulation-only bind/sidecar scope; emit elaborated-hierarchy requirements; and derive deadlock/AXI targets from the exact board-source identity and Vivado facts. This preserves hardware behavior and checker strength while making the next board trace trustworthy.

observations: The failed hierarchy layer is board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system: functional_sim failed, while multilayer functional, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, and board semantic gates are dependency-blocked rather than independent hardware failures.

The historical exact-board run accepted all 1792 core-ingress stream beats for 16 tokens while ready core egress accepted zero beats. This proves the historical board run failed, but it does not select a current RTL root cause after the matching lower-layer contradiction replay passed.

The completed connected-kernel replay is closed capability evidence: fresh remote VCS execution observed all 1792 ingress and 1792 egress beats, terminal egress last, boundary liveness pass, and 416 accepted boundary records. No connected-kernel replay or repair may be scheduled without a new exact-board trace bound to the current certificate and explicitly contradicting a named invariant.

The current repair signature has current_board_to_lower_layer_contradiction=null. The stale kernel_start_precedes_stage0_input assertion conflicts with live hash-validated lifecycle knowledge: the first accepted core-ingress handshake is the start witness, and a separate lifecycle pulse may follow. It must not be used to patch block_input or gate ingress.

The earliest actionable defect is in verification capability: invalid debug-observability schema, instrumentation not proven simulation-only, missing current-DAG boundary declarations, a dynamic record missing schema_version, absent elaborated-hierarchy evidence, and a deadlock/AXI checker bound to legacy literal interface names instead of discovered board facts.

The exact sample wrapper identity already passed and binds the wrapper, compute-slot ABI, AXI interfaces, timing contract, Vivado facts, and source closure. A simplified wrapper, modified wrapper baseline, or guessed interface name is prohibited.

The immutable transfer contract remains seq_len=16 and width=896, corresponding to 1792 256-bit stream beats and 896 512-bit AXI beats in token/tile/lane/word order. Checker repair must not conflate stream-beat and AXI-beat counts.

Expected output remains independent target-model inference with sha256=92fc53de80c8caca6ea04cc69ab768a1f6db0e55a2ab0ebbd9ac0adc6e3c85b4 for input fingerprint sha256=4b3948f8c0038b657d1761286c9db47c1b951cd245953fb552a05714beb696d4 and semantic testbench sha256=508f38c4b8fb9c1ac16e8191cccc4ee1a15f3ab862cfbfbb3821f312646df82f. Numeric comparison was not run, so no functional or numeric pass exists.

Runtime counters and twelve validation-scope tensor hashes do not yet prove executed schedule-, address-, data-, last-, lifecycle-, and exactly-once weight consumption. That evidence remains required on a later passing board run.
The accelerator and golden boundary remain Transformer block output only. Embedding, tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work must not be added.

sacg_memory_truth authoritatively reports 24 active same-scope contamination barriers, eight open retry requests, and zero open same-scope backtrack requests. The barriers and retries remain active and block downstream consumption or promotion; they do not authorize a lower-layer backtrack and do not independently prevent this refined bounded current-stage contract from being checked.
The prior repair execution report is untrusted because its referenced LLM input failed fingerprint validation. It may be cited only as quarantined failure history, not as proof of a repair or pass.
proposed_actions: Execute only repair.current_board_observability_and_checker_contract. After all named acceptance checkers pass, hand the accepted artifacts back to Stage7 for selection of a fresh exact-wrapper functional_sim rerun; that rerun and all dependent gates are intentionally not scheduled by this decision.
Keep the connected-kernel replay closed and retain all 24 contamination barriers and eight retry requests until a fresh complete board-layer pass is later produced and separately reconciled.
risks: Patching block_input, kernel.mlp_down, or connected-kernel pipeline control from the stale trace would improperly reopen certified lower-layer behavior and could destroy verified elastic overlap semantics.

Replacing the false lifecycle assertion must not remove real output-liveness, order, protocol, transfer-count, or loader-consumption checks; doing so would bypass acceptance rather than repair verification capability.
Placing probes in synthesizable design RTL could alter DUT behavior or sample-project identity. Instrumentation must be confined to simulation bind/sidecar scope.
Hardcoding legacy AXI names could select the wrong interface despite the passed board-source and Vivado identity evidence.
Reusing the invalid repair report or contaminated Stage7/Stage8 artifacts as trusted inputs could repeat the fingerprint-integrity failure.
Independent AXI traffic, heartbeat, prefetch, or runtime-load counters cannot substitute for core egress, output FIFO/writeback, protocol, numeric, or executed weight-consumption evidence.
Changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model output, numeric tolerance, data order, memory layout, semantic testbench, or exact wrapper to obtain a pass is prohibited.
Running VCS or dependent board gates before this observability/checker contract passes would produce another untrustworthy current-layer trace and prolong the repair loop.
